description: Prometheus exporter to execute scripts and collect metrics from the output or the exit status.

summary.one_liner: A Prometheus exporter that runs configured scripts on each scrape and exposes metrics parsed from their output, plus their exit status and execution duration.
use_cases: Monitor a host with a custom shell script and alert on its exit status
Turn a Nagios plugin's output into Prometheus metrics
Count files in a Docker container and expose the number as a metric
Ping a target address and record whether it succeeded
Cache expensive script results between Prometheus scrapes
Run privileged checks via sudo and export the results
notable: Scripts are defined in a YAML config file and selected per scrape via a 'script' query parameter on /probe
Parses script output as Prometheus metrics or Nagios plugin output
Built-in result caching with configurable duration and optional use of expired cache on error
Config reload at runtime via SIGHUP or HTTP POST to /-/reload
Prometheus HTTP service discovery support to generate scrape targets from scripts and their params
caveats: Cache is not persisted; it is cleared when the exporter restarts
Sudo use requires separately creating the matching sudoers entries
Timeouts can fail to be enforced for child processes unless wait_delay is set to a low value
